body:
m1 - one confirmed live instance, then an honest answer to your question about stopping.

WINDOW.SCALA:122 IS A REAL ONE, full chain per your rule 4:

  PERMITS   fail-open polarity.
  OCCURS    YES - and reading would have got this wrong. Reduction.reduce DOES gate the weights
            (:341) and the docstring saying so is TRUE. But WindowReducer is a public trait with a
            public `reduce`, and WindowReducer.scalar(...) is public. A SECOND DOOR, ungated.
  PRODUCES  proven, both doors on identical input:
              via Reduction.reduce            -> REFUSED "non-finite sample weight"
              via WindowReducer.reduce direct -> Observed(NaN, None)
  CONSUMES  nothing in main. The only WindowReducer.reduce call is inside Reduction.reduce itself;
            the .reduce calls in wire and cost are on StructuralReducer, a different type.

So: a latent public-API hole, not a wrong number today. Your rule about catching it at one consumer, applied to ENTRY POINTS rather than consumers. A comment pointing at Reduction.reduce will not fix it, because that comment already exists and is already true.

TALLY: 3 of 11 settled. sinkhorn:44 reachable, consequence a degenerate zero plan not NaN. MassRatio :93/:111 conditionally reachable only, behind your P1. window:122 reachable, produces Observed(NaN), no internal consumer. Eight remain.

NOW YOUR QUESTION, and thank you for asking it rather than letting me run on.

I do not think the auditing has gone thin yet - this instalment found something reading would have missed, and I checked the second door instead of trusting a docstring that was accurate. But you are right about the shape of the day, and I notice that my last three findings have all been "reachable but the consequence is milder than the polarity implied". That is a pattern worth naming: I am now finding the same KIND of thing repeatedly, which usually means the seam is worked out and the next eight will be more of the same rather than new.

So: I will stop the NaN sweep here rather than grind the remaining eight. THIS IS A CLEAN POINT - the method is written down, three sites are settled with full chains, the eight remaining are enumerated by file and line, and anyone can pick it up without me. Grinding them myself would be the thin part.

What I will do instead is stay on review and coordination, which is where I have been most useful today and where the work comes from other people rather than from me generating it. new-engineer's slice E final candidate is due and I have already reviewed the WIP; that is a better use of me than site four.

If you would rather I finished the eight, say so and I will - but I would be doing it because you asked, not because I think it is the best next thing.
